# Procfu

ProcFu enhances Podio's capabilities by providing a suite of automation tools and functions, enabling users to create scripts, mini apps, and integrate with various services to streamline workflows.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/procfu/.

## Actions

- **Ask question to OpenAI GPT**: Ask a question to OpenAI GPT.
- **Generate Image with OpenAI**: Generate an image via OpenAI API.
- **Get Google Sheet contents as array** (read-only): Get sheet contents as array.
- **Get Google Sheets Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata of a Google Sheets spreadsheet, including sheet names, IDs, and properties.
- **Array Diff New** (read-only): Return items added in the second JSON array.
- **Array Diff Same** (read-only): Get items present in both JSON arrays.
- **Array Difference Deletions** (read-only): Return items removed when comparing two JSON arrays.
- **Array Sort** (read-only): Sort a JSON array of values.
- **Delete Google Drive**: Delete a Google Drive file or folder.
- **Generate dummy data**: Generate dummy data.
- **Google Drive Delete**: Delete a Google Drive file or folder.
